release.name: v2.0.1 – Stable Release
release.body:
# 🚀 Highlights

Version 2.0.0 is a major update focused on improving the overall quality, usability, and stability of C Games Collection.

---

## ✨ New Features

- Improved game launcher experience
- Enhanced navigation across the application
- Better score management
- Refined game flow

---

## 🎨 UI & UX Improvements

- Modern GTK4 interface refinements
- Improved spacing and layout consistency
- Better typography
- Updated dialogs
- More polished game cards
- Improved accessibility

---

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Fixed various UI inconsistencies
- Improved error handling
- Better memory management
- Fixed layout issues
- General stability improvements

---

## ⚡ Performance

- Faster application startup
- Reduced unnecessary redraws
- Improved responsiveness

---

## 📚 Documentation

- Refined README
- Updated architecture documentation
- Improved contributing guide
- Better project documentation consistency

---

## ❤️ Thank You

Thank you for using and supporting C Games Collection!

If you encounter any issues, please open an issue in this repository.
